title: Release notes
description: One release's player-facing notes (GH-1622). data/release-notes/next.json (version "next") is drafted on dev before each promotion and its wording is approved by the lead inside the promotion PR; the version job on main renames it to v<X.Y.Z>.json (version "X.Y.Z") in the release bump commit, writes a fresh empty next.json, and publishes the GitHub release from it (tools/ci/release-notes-md.mjs). Every entry is one line of plain player English. The filter gate in tools/validate_release_notes.mjs refuses internal words, PR and issue references, git hashes and snake_case ids, and holds each filename to its version. Drafting guide: docs/agent-notes/release-notes.md.

version.description: "next" in next.json; the released version, without the leading v, in v<X.Y.Z>.json.

rules.description: New or changed rules and features, shown under "Rules and features".

fixes.description: Fixes a player would notice, shown under "Fixes".

items.description: One line, 1-160 characters, no leading or trailing whitespace, no line break.
